paragraphs.notes: Continuation page: the whole body is one unbroken enumeration of substituent group names that begins on an earlier page and continues past the last line. The page opens mid-term ("alkyl-amino,", the tail of a name whose head is printed at the foot of the previous page) and closes with a comma after "Halogenalkinylcarbonyl,", with no terminating punctuation. The patent carries no [00NN] paragraph markers, so marker is null. Transcription joins the printed lines into flowing text; where a line ended with a word-internal hyphen ("...-N-alkyl-" / "amino", "N-Alkyl-N-" / "arylaminocarbonyl", "N-Alkyl-N-" / "heteroarylaminocarbonyl") the halves are joined without a space, while the standalone hyphen of "Mono-" at the end of a line is kept and joined to the following "oder" with a space, as printed. The German is limited to the connectives "gegebenenfalls substituiertes" (optionally substituted), "Mono-" and "oder" and to the German spellings of the group names; en therefore differs from zh mainly in those connectives, in lower-casing the group names, and in rendering German "Alkinyl" as English "alkynyl" and "Halogen-" as "halo-", following the convention already used in this run's other vision files. Printed as-is and not corrected: the list gives "gegebenenfalls substituiertes Mono- oder Dialkylcarbonylamino" and its Diaryl-/Diheteroaryl- partners immediately after the N-Alkyl-N-heteroarylaminocarbonyl entry, i.e. no aminocarbonyloxy or aminocarbonylamino series appears on this page.
